issues.description: The template Main.java uses a non-existent method name 'feed()' (commented code) while the problem statement and the solution expect 'feedAllAnimals()'. This name mismatch in the template's example code can confuse students about the correct API to implement or to call.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template example consistent with the specification and solution: either change the commented example in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java to call farm.feedAllAnimals(), or add a small adapter method 'public void feed() { feedAllAnimals(); }' to the Farm template so both names work during exercises.

issues.description: The operation to feed all animals is named feedAllAnimals() in the problem statement and in the solution Main, but the provided template Main calls farm.feed(). This inconsistent method name for the same concept (feeding all animals) can confuse students because the supplied Main refers to a method that does not match the task specification and the solution's API.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template Main use the same method name as the specification and solution: replace farm.feed() with farm.feedAllAnimals(). Alternatively, add a short delegating method feed() in the Farm template that calls feedAllAnimals() to preserve the provided Main while matching the specified API.
